text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE single full-body image. 2:3 portrait canvas, head-to-toe uncut, complete hair and shoes, 6% margin top and bottom. Strict straight-on FRONT view, head upright face symmetrical, shoulders and hips level, relaxed arms at sides hands visible, feet slightly apart on same baseline. Long lens neutral undistorted straight camera, no perspective foreshortening. Character-specific body: 183 cm, slim youthful lightly athletic build. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Long washed charcoal wide straight cargo trousers at natural waist, grey-white skate sneakers, black backpack; same baseball cap, oversized sports T-shirt and silver chain.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 23. Black unbranded baseball cap worn normally, black choppy fringe framing open eyes. Gray-brown slightly round downturned eyes, gently tapered face, soft wide cheeks, short straight nose, broad lower lip, thick horizontal eyebrows. Warm light tan skin. Oversized washed charcoal sports tee with two muted gray shoulder panels, fine silver curb necklace, simple black backpack straps. Relaxed independent streetwear mood.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
